summary: Executed backend pytest regression and full frontend SPA/navigation integration tests on the current public preview URL, including rapid route switching, brochure delivery/viewer, contact submission, and responsive checks.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking the mobile CTA link for Modular Kitchens from Home accordion did not navigate to /services#modular-kitchens during 3 repeated attempts; URL remained '/'.

integration_issues.issue: One hero/home image source fails to load (naturalWidth=0) due invalid remote image id.

action_items: Fix Home mobile service accordion link navigation for [data-testid='service-mobile-link-modular-kitchens'] so it reliably routes to /services#modular-kitchens.
Replace/fix broken image source in /app/frontend/src/content/images.js (kitchenDark id: 1771270731051-9cfbb7222946).
After fixes, re-run mobile Home->Services deep-link flow and all-images naturalWidth health check.
critical_code_review_comments: P0 blank-route recurrence appears resolved: rapid header/footer SPA navigation kept main opacity=1 and visible content across Projects/Brochure/Services/Studio/Process/Gallery/Contact.
Brochure implementation aligns with requirement: direct native downloads for all CTA variants and 7-page preview/lightbox controls worked without form gating.
Data-quality risk: a broken remote image on homepage degrades premium visual experience and should be treated as release-blocking for design polish.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_UI_ITER5_<timestamp> enquiry via contact form submit and verified via /api/enquiries admin list.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Desktop 1920x800 and mobile 390x844 core flows were tested. Header/menu boundary at 1279/1280 passed. Direct /services#modular-kitchens deep-link passed desktop/mobile (~95px top). Contact preset type from service CTA passed (Modular Kitchen) and submit persisted in backend. Brochure viewer tabs count=7, lightbox keyboard/Escape/containment passed, all brochure download buttons returned Suvi-Interior-Brochure.pdf. Remaining blockers: mobile Home accordion CTA link navigation and one broken homepage image URL.
rca_of_the_issue: Mobile CTA issue reproduction: On 390x844, open Home -> services accordion section 'Modular Kitchens' -> click [data-testid='service-mobile-link-modular-kitchens']. Across three attempts, aria-expanded toggled true and panel rendered, but navigation did not occur and URL stayed '/'. Possible causes include click target overlap/stacking with sticky bar, event interception, or link interaction conflict within the accordion state change cycle. Broken image RCA: /app/frontend/src/content/images.js defines kitchenDark with id '1771270731051-9cfbb7222946' which returns an unavailable remote asset, resulting in naturalWidth=0 on homepage image checks.
